---
title: "A kept table, and a figure after its heading"
mdbrand:
  brand: none
  style: note
---

A table inside a `::: {.keep}` block left longtable's end-of-table penalty in
the kept box. Set on the page, it reached LaTeX's output routine as a float
request with no float: the page was held with no goal, the section before the
block and the table never printed, and the next figure came out on a page of
its own before the heading of its section (a LoRaWAN evaluation, exit 0).
Everything must print, and each figure after its heading.
